title: Lights Out

serves.summary: The learner predicts which toys can still be seen in a dark room by marking the ones the flashlight reaches or that make their own light, which shows that light is needed to see.

request.objective: Predict which objects can be seen in a dark room: only those that light reaches, or that make their own light (1-PS4-2, SCI001-04-d)

problems.ask: The big light is going off. Put an eye on every toy you will still see.
problems.goal: The bear and the duck, the two toys in the beam, have an eye; the ball and the car do not.
